page_new.excerpt: # Run and result provenance contract **Question.** What must a run record preserve so that another reader can replay it and see what the run did not establish? **Short answer.** A run record binds the model and scenario by SHA-256, records the engine version, seed base, replication count, input hash, Python and platform, invocation, metrics, convergence, uncertainty, sensitivity and limitations. It also stores a result hash over the record's substantive fields.
